item.title: All These Powerful Political Figures Had a Close Relationship With Epstein
item.description: Released correspondence shows Jeffrey Epstein maintained relationships with Peter Mandelson and former Israeli prime minister Ehud Barak after his 2008 conviction. The records document continued political access, though association alone does not establish involvement in his crimes.

item.title: Cai Xukun Was Edited Out, But Viewers Spotted His Hands
item.description: Chinese singer Cai Xukun was digitally removed from a 2023 episode of Keep Running, but viewers spotted traces of him, including his hands. The edit followed allegations that he pressured a woman into an abortion. Cai acknowledged their past relationship but denied coercion or illegal conduct.

item.title: Maxwell Called The Prince Andrew Photo Fake From Prison
item.description: In a 2023 prison interview, Ghislaine Maxwell claimed the photograph of Prince Andrew with Virginia Giuffre was fake—a claim Giuffre rejected.

item.title: Prince Andrew Said He Cut Ties. His Emails Said Otherwise
item.description: Prince Andrew said he ended contact with Jeffrey Epstein in December 2010. Emails later revealed correspondence in 2011, contradicting that account. Andrew denies Virginia Giuffre’s sexual abuse allegations and settled her civil lawsuit in 2022 without admitting wrongdoing.

item.title: One Juror Held Out In Lindsay Clancy’s Murder Trial
item.description: Eleven jurors favored finding Lindsay Clancy not guilty by reason of insanity in her three children’s deaths, but one disagreed. Her trial ended in a September 2026 mistrial. A judge denied her acquittal request on October 1; a retrial decision remains pending.

item.title: His Camera Revealed What Happened On His Final Dive
item.description: In January 2005, Australian diver Dave Shaw died attempting to recover Deon Dreyer’s body from a South African cave, ten years after Dreyer disappeared. Shaw’s helmet camera revealed his struggle with an entangled line. Both divers’ bodies were recovered four days later.

item.title: He Posted His Plan Online Before Killing Three Coworkers
item.description: Randy Stair, 24, posted a video outlining his planned attack before killing three coworkers at a Pennsylvania Weis supermarket on June 8, 2017. Investigators examined his online videos and journals. He died by suicide at the scene before police arrived.
